# Project Brief

Status: Accepted

## Target Milestone

Personal reading list MVP

## Product Outcome

A reader can capture books, track whether each book has been read, and focus
the list by reading status.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A reader can add a book with a title.
2. A reader can view all captured books.
3. A reader can mark a book as read or unread.
4. A reader can filter books by reading status.

## Non Goals

- Accounts or synchronization.
- Recommendations.
- Social sharing.
